_comment: Shared TypeScript/Rust arithmetic vectors (ADR-0026). Decoded and asserted by packages/types and services/matching, so the duplicated fixed-point arithmetic cannot drift silently. prompt_phase_s1.md rules 76 and 137.

notional.name: SOL/USDC at 150, one whole SOL
notional.note: the worked example in ADR-0026: 150000000 quote base units == 150 USDC

notional.name: truncates toward zero, smallest possible product
notional.note: 1 * 1 / 1e9 == 0. The residual is not charged to anyone.

notional.name: rounding boundary, one below a whole unit
rounding boundary, exactly a whole unit
rounding boundary, one above a whole unit
intermediate exceeds u64 but the result does not
notional.note: 1.5e8 * 1e15 == 1.5e23, far above u64 max 1.8e19. This vector is the reason Rust must multiply in u128; a u64 intermediate wraps here.

notionalOverflow.name: result exceeds u64
notionalOverflow.note: 1e19 * 1e10 / 1e9 == 1e20, above u64 max. Must be an error, never a wrap.

fee.name: fee truncation on a fractional boundary

isMultipleOf.name: zero is a multiple of anything
